web.how: On every join, Kron finds the invite used and who created it. A member counts as valid while they stay; if they leave, they move to “left”; an account that is too new counts as “fake”.
web.announceHint: For example in the welcome channel: “@Bob joined the server, invited by Bill who now has 25 invites!”
web.logHint: Every join and leave with the invite, the inviter and the account age. Placed in the server’s logs category.
web.firstJoin: After turning it on, the very first join can stay “unknown”: Kron learns the server’s invites then.
